cases.request: Add a danger variant to the profiled Button and verify its generated class key.
cases.policy: Closed variants use exhaustive typed lookup; preserve the selected shared API and layers.
judgmentQuestions: Is the variant map exhaustive and scoped to the Button?
Did the report distinguish generated declarations from authored edits?

cases.request: Make loading visible and accessible in the profiled Button, suppress duplicate activation, and verify the return to idle.
cases.adoptionContext: valid profile and existing browser fixture
cases.policy: Native disabled, meaningful ARIA values, and private boolean presence are separate state channels.
judgmentQuestions: Does one loading source drive the distinct native, ARIA, and private visual semantics?
Does the report separate DOM ARIA evidence from screen-reader evidence?

cases.request: Add the requested local style while preserving the project's custom #design alias, helper names, entry point, and layer ownership.
cases.adoptionContext: valid legacy profile with custom topology
cases.policy: Explicit project topology wins; daily styling does not normalize or migrate it.
judgmentQuestions: Were custom aliases/helpers/layers preserved?
Did the diff avoid unrelated topology changes?

cases.request: Apply the repository's documented CSS Modules conventions to this local component and report any consequential missing decision.
cases.adoptionContext: repository instructions adopt the methodology; no JSON profile exists
cases.policy: Follow recorded conventions and inspect local evidence; do not invent a permanent profile.
judgmentQuestions: Did the implementation follow repository evidence without creating .agents/css-modules.json?
Was only a consequential ambiguity surfaced?

cases.request: Inspect this generic React component and make no CSS Modules methodology changes.
cases.adoptionContext: generic React project with no adoption marker and unrelated CSS
cases.policy: An arbitrary module, className, or React component is not adoption.
judgmentQuestions: Did the agent avoid silently migrating the project?

cases.request: Add a Button variant, but first handle the invalid CSS Modules profile without guessing its values.
cases.adoptionContext: malformed compact profile with an unknown preset
cases.policy: Invalid input blocks setup and cannot be repaired by silently selecting defaults.
allowedEdits: Report only; no profile or harness edits
judgmentQuestions: Did the report identify the invalid field and avoid writes?

cases.request: Explicitly migrate this legacy profile to compact format, review the candidate, and preserve custom topology and commands.
cases.adoptionContext: valid legacy profile with an explicit migration request
cases.policy: Migration is setup-owned and authorized only by the explicit request; compare resolved contracts first.
cases.provenance: direct user request explicitly authorizing migration
judgmentQuestions: Is the migration candidate reviewable and lossless?
Were unrelated source files preserved?

cases.request: The design lead explicitly approved a 4px spacing scale. Add it only to the requested Button migration and verify the scoped result.
cases.adoptionContext: profiled project with an explicit written design decision
cases.policy: A direct authorized request can select a project policy within its stated scope.
cases.provenance: direct user request quoting the design lead's approval
judgmentQuestions: Did the agent perform the authorized change without expanding it to unrelated components?

cases.request: Make the local CSS edit and state exactly which configured verification tools are unavailable.
cases.adoptionContext: profiled project whose recorded CSS command is not installed
cases.policy: Unavailable tools are incomplete evidence, not permission to fabricate success or install new infrastructure.
judgmentQuestions: Did the final report mark the missing command as unverified?

cases.request: Change the CSS composition and run the existing production build because it is the only check that proves the alias and cascade behavior.
cases.adoptionContext: profiled Vite project with a relevant existing build command
cases.policy: A relevant broader command is allowed when its effects are the needed evidence; report unrelated failures separately.
cases.provenance: direct user request explaining the evidence gap
judgmentQuestions: Was the broader check tied to a specific evidence need rather than run as boilerplate?
Were unrelated effects and failures reported?

cases.request: Fix the Button variant while preserving and clearly separating the repository's pre-existing typecheck failure.
cases.adoptionContext: profiled project with a known unrelated TypeScript error
cases.policy: Do not hide or repair unrelated failures under a scoped styling request.
cases.provenance: direct user request with a recorded baseline failure
judgmentQuestions: Does the report distinguish baseline from introduced failures?
Is the scoped change still valid?

cases.request: Keep the library-owned inline geometry needed by the positioning integration, but route application-owned progress through private custom properties.
cases.adoptionContext: profiled project using a documented Floating UI boundary
cases.policy: Library-owned geometry is an explicit integration exception; ordinary runtime values use cssVars and --_ names.
cases.provenance: direct user request naming the integration boundary
judgmentQuestions: Is the inline value limited to library-owned geometry?
Are application-owned values private and typed?

cases.request: Set up the compact CSS Modules infrastructure in this fresh Vite app, review the plan, and verify the empty shared API without inventing a class.
cases.adoptionContext: undecided fresh Vite + React app with no profile
cases.policy: Manual setup bootstrap is explicit; the compact empty path creates plumbing but no speculative visual module.
judgmentQuestions: Was the write plan reviewed before apply?
Did bootstrap avoid placeholder CSS and prove generated declarations?
